provenance.logotype_raster: logotype.jpg (4652 × 792) — the source logotype lockup, only reference for letters other than g
provenance.vector_refit: 20260809_g_refit-22pt.svg — 22 cubic points, knots at extrema, max deviation 7.9 units from the trace
provenance.scale_factor_note: Logotype pixels × 1.439 = font units. Derived from the g, whose descender/bowl-top ratio (0.330) matches the logotype g exactly (0.330).

vertical_metrics.note: The refit g needs no scaling — its existing coordinates already sit correctly on these metrics. Bowl top 528.1 = xHeight 521 + 7 overshoot. Tail bottom -174.2 sits just inside descender -178.

weight.note: Measured by scanline across the refit g. Bowl sides 106.2 / 106.9 at y=440; loop sides 105.7 / 105.1 at y=-50. Bowl top 63.1, loop bottom 52.2. This is a Bold-to-Black master, NOT monolinear — any weight axis must preserve the 105:60 ratio.

spacing.note: Gaps measured between letter ink bounds in the logotype. Generous for the weight, consistent with the soft rounded drawing.

caveats: The logotype baseline is not level — it rises ~34px across 4190px (0.46°). Measure each letter against its own local baseline, not a global one.
'u' is the only flat-topped lowercase, so it gives true x-height (360px). Round letters e/a/o read 361–374px because they overshoot.
Cap height differs slightly between B (499px) and D (495px) — scan noise, not design intent. Use 715 units for both.
